column1: # cuts.tsv — cut definitions. TAB-separated. Copy to pipeline/cuts.tsv and fill in.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# Columns (the header row below is required; extra columns are ignored):
#   ep        episode label; also the per-episode output folder name (e.g. EP01)
#   source    video filename; looked up in <dir>/<source> or <dir>/<ep>/<source>
#   start     start timestamp HH:MM:SS[.mmm]  (ignored if 'segments' is set)
#   end       end timestamp                    (ignored if 'segments' is set)
#   title     short title for the cut (used in the .docx)
#   quote     the quotable line (used in the .docx)
#   why       one line: why this cut was chosen (see criteria.md)
#   cx        OPTIONAL 0-1 horizontal face center for the 9:16 crop (else default 0.5)
#   segments  OPTIONAL 'start->end;start->end' to STITCH complementary pieces into one cut
# Timestamps refer to the ORIGINAL episode video (the .vtt/.txt share its basename).
